title: Abbas tera haq hai
body:
Abbas tera haq hai
Abbas, Abbas, Abbas..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera haq hai zamana tujhe roye..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shaam o sahar fatima zahra tujhe roye
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera haq hai zamana tujhe roye..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye abbas..
1. Durra liye pehre pe sitamgaar khada hai..(2)
kaise tere laashe pe sakina tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jis waqt uthaya na gaya laasha jawa'n ka..(2)
sheh us ghadi akbar se zyaada tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Zainab ne kaha shame ghareeba mein aye ghaazi..(2)
be parda mujhe dekhke baba tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sajde ke liye jab liya haatho ka sahara..(2) to sajjad musalle pe hamesha tujhe roye
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bin haath ke kis tarha tu ghode se gira tha..(2)
ye sunke bohot ehle madina tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Mashkiza kahi'n, jism kahi'n, haath kahi'n hai
jaa jaa ke kaha'n fatima zahra tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Armaan sakina ka tha jitna tujhe roti..(2)
sajjad teri qabr pe utna tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hashim ke qamar kyu na tera chaahne wala...(2)
wa-sh- shams ka padte hue sura tujhe roye..(2)
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Hasrat hai ke ghazi ho lahu aankh se jaari..(2)
ye mir takallum kabhi aisa tujhe roye
jab sham o sahar fatima zahra tujhe roye
<<MINI>>
Abbas tera..
<<DIVIDER>>
haye abbas....
